scope: Read-only independent review of pantry recommendation/search changes, publication health checks, and dark-default theme. No secrets inspected.

pantryRecommendation.initialFinding: Pareto frontier IDs were computed but displayed alternatives used only the first three scalar-score options. This could surface dominated options while omitting non-dominated tradeoffs.
pantryRecommendation.recheck: Fixed: displayed alternativeIds now prioritizes non-dominated frontier options and fills remaining slots from scalar-ranked options. The new lower-score tradeoff fixture verifies the tradeoff appears first.
pantryRecommendation.reviewConclusion: No remaining concrete logic defect found in the reviewed recommendation/search path. New tests cover deterministic IDs, hard pre-route exclusions, candidate limits, route identity, verification/timing/return gates, and incomplete-search status.

publicationHealth.sourceReview: The dynamic Node health endpoint returns only ok/unavailable with no-store and nosniff headers, and reports database readiness without requiring optional providers. The Docker image runs as the unprivileged node user; Compose gates Caddy on the local app health check and persists SQLite on a named volume. Caddy's reviewed configuration has no request access-log directive.
publicationHealth.reportedRuntimeEvidence: docs/PUBLISHING.md records a successful local image/runtime check: UID 1000, SQLite mode 0600, health/home/pantry/account-status HTTP 200, persistence and backup/restore checks, and disabled email worker processing zero messages. These are recorded main-agent observations, not checks independently repeated for this review.
notVerifiedHere: No public-domain HTTPS deployment or external health request was performed by this reviewer.
No Docker build, runtime, backup, or restore command was rerun by this reviewer.

darkDefault.sourceReview: The document bootstrap, CSS theme default, and hydrated toggle all resolve absent, invalid, or blocked storage to reach-dark while preserving an explicitly stored light/dark choice. The focused browser test source covers pre-hydration first paint, OS scheme changes, blocked storage, saved choice persistence, and cross-tab removal.
darkDefault.reportedEvidence: docs/evidence/default-dark-mobile.png was visually inspected and shows the expected dark first-visit mobile interface. Browser tests and screenshot generation were not independently rerun in this review.
darkDefault.reviewConclusion: No material defect found in the reviewed dark-default path.
